name: The Original Oyster House
description: The Original Oyster House is the best oyster bar & seafood restaurant in Gulf Shores & Mobile, AL. Known for hand-shucked raw, charbroiled and baked oysters, the Original Oyster House is legendary for fresh Gulf seafood, Southern hospitality and spectacular waterfront views. With vintage seafood house charm, the Original Oyster House offers award-winning gumbo, alligator, crab claws, fish, shrimp, crawfish, burgers, po'boys and a create-your-own seafood platter. Fantastic salad bar, over-the-top cheesy grits and homemade key lime or chocolate chip peanut butter pies are local favorites. Specialty drinks, spirits, wines and beers pair wonderfully with the large menu selection and happy hour on the Causeway. Great kid's menu plus an outdoor playground. Behind the scenes, this restaurant's sustainable practices have taken oysters out of the kitchen to help save oysters and ensure their future. Becoming the first restaurant in the state to recycle the oyster shell through the AL Coastal Foundation, the Original Oyster House pledged further by being the only local restaurant to 'oyster garden' or grow stocker oysters for reef restoration.
